description: This is a test class for the AttributeCreated class within the org.eclipse.ditto.signals.events.things package. It contains unit tests verifying immutability, equals/hashCode, constructor validation, JSON serialization/deserialization, and other behaviors related to AttributeCreated objects.

classes.name: AttributeCreatedTest
classes.description: Unit test class for AttributeCreated, verifying behaviors like immutability, equals/hashCode, JSON serialization/deserialization, and constructor validation.

methods.name: assertImmutability
methods.description: Verifies that AttributeCreated instances are immutable and that JsonPointer and JsonValue are also immutable.

methods.name: testHashCodeAndEquals
methods.description: Runs against the EqualsVerifier to ensure proper implementation of equals and hashCode for AttributeCreated.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullThingIdString
methods.description: Tests that creating AttributeCreated with a null ThingId string throws ThingIdInvalidException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullThingId
methods.description: Tests that creating AttributeCreated with a null ThingId object throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: tryToCreateInstanceWithNullAttributeKey
methods.description: Tests that creating AttributeCreated with a null attribute key throws NullPointerException.

methods.name: toJsonReturnsExpected
methods.description: Checks that calling toJson on AttributeCreated produces the expected JSON object.

methods.name: createInstanceFromValidJson
methods.description: Tests deserialization of AttributeCreated from a JSON string and verifies correctness of fields.
